toolbox: AHR and ATT fill sky then call X.HR, aliased to lcd.drawHudRectangle.
aerodeck: Cockpit fills sky then calls the same native lcd.drawHudRectangle, with overlay scales.
userImpact: The base attitude field uses the same radio rendering primitive. Primitive versus bitmap alone does not establish superiority.
acceptance: Match native field orientation at level, ±20° pitch, ±35° and ±90° bank and inverted on target radio.

feature: CRSF pitch sign and angle units
toolbox: TBS GYRO converts radians to degrees and negates pitch only; roll/yaw retain sign.
aerodeck: read(...,pitch) negates radians pitch; roll/yaw convert without negation. Degree sources are accepted as already normalized.
userImpact: A sign error would invert climb/descent cues. The CRSF transform matches in code.
acceptance: On the same quad physically verify level, nose-up/down, right/left bank and inverted. Separately verify degree-unit inputs are normalized by their producer.

toolbox: Native HUD receives unrounded D.S.ATT_PITCH/ROLL; numeric captions are floored separately.
aerodeck: Native HUD receives current unrounded values. Overlay uses sin(roll)*pitch and cos(roll)*pitch*1.85 with datum(240,154), matching native 2.12.4 projection.
userImpact: Matching field and overlaid ladder projection prevents a sliding datum error.
acceptance: At every pose, ensure native horizon, zero rung and aircraft datum remain coincident where applicable; include ±90° and ±180°.

toolbox: Original AHR computes pitch-dependent RGB: ground(20,235−1.5 s,20), sky(45+1.5 s,45+1.5 s,255), with s=min(floor(abs(pitch)),90). ATT uses theme sky/ground colors.
aerodeck: Current full app uses fixed sky#2070 a 6 and ground#755831 plus contrast lines. Both apps distinguish sky from ground; exact gradients are optional visual choices.
userImpact: Both distinguish sky/ground; exact colors and textures are optional aesthetic choices.
acceptance: At 30–40 cm outdoors verify distinguishable field orientation through all poses, including color-vision variation. Do not require copying Toolbox colors.

toolbox: AHR caches DBD_AHL.png, a 30×6 RGBA aircraft marker. ATT has dotted fixed horizontal reference.
aerodeck: 88 px orange aircraft wings with black halo and 6 px center datum; fixed over moving field.
userImpact: A larger datum is present; functional improvement depends on viewing-distance and pose readability, not drawing method.
acceptance: Read datum immediately at 30–40 cm; preserve zero alignment and avoid ladder-caption collisions in bank/inverted flight.

toolbox: Original AHR draws native horizon, aircraft, speed/altitude tapes and numerical P/R; no pitch-rung drawing loop or ladder bitmap. ATT tick ring is fixed angular perimeter.
aerodeck: 10° rungs within±40° of pitch,20° signed SMLSIZE labels, zero horizon emphasized; clips transformed rungs to inner field.
userImpact: Adds quantitative pitch reference to the attitude view.
acceptance: Verify signed 20° labels and 10° rungs at normal/bank 35/pitch 10/90 bank/inverted; labels must stay separate and never obscure datum.

toolbox: AHR and ATT show numerical pitch/roll; ATT names each value.
aerodeck: Persistent P/R signed degree readouts at upper cockpit corners; uses current values.
userImpact: Quantitative angle reading remains available despite removal of circular bezel.
acceptance: Native fonts must remain readable and fit±180° without crossing field/heading or ladder labels.

toolbox: ATT foreground 108×109 JPEG mask supplies circular tick marks; ring is static, yaw dot is separate.
aerodeck: No circular graduated reference or bank pointer. Numeric roll and ladder/field provide angle information, but equivalence of the graduated angular reference is not proven.
userImpact: Reading a number is a different perceptual task from judging orientation against a graduated reference.
acceptance: Provide an equally effective graduated angular reference in the AERODECK design, or demonstrate same-radio bank-direction/magnitude recognition at least as good as Toolbox. Exact circular bezel artwork is not required.

toolbox: ATT shows numerical YAW and a radius 47 green point when yaw exists.
aerodeck: Yaw is available numerically on Telemetry; full Flight compass is GPS course Hdg, not yaw.
dependencies: Yaw source distinct from GPS course
userImpact: Stationary aircraft orientation cannot be inferred from course-over-ground.
acceptance: Provide an explicitly labeled yaw/heading orientation option or separate display without silently substituting GPS course.

toolbox: ATT draws native rectangle through cached background aperture/foreground masks; AHR is rectangular.
aerodeck: Rectangular cockpit with opaque side tapes; moving rungs and extra horizon line clipped numerically inside intended field. No cockpit image decode on warm draw.
userImpact: Both constrain moving field to a designated instrument region.
acceptance: No field/rung/caption escapes its view at 45 pose combinations and extreme angle limits; native radio verification still required.

toolbox: AHR/ATT native calls fallback to 0 when an attitude component is nil; dashboard also dims telemetry-off elements. Exact recovered dim conditions are malformed and not trusted.
aerodeck: Both pitch and roll must be current and valid; otherwise ATTITUDE UNAVAILABLE, no synthetic level field.
userImpact: Explicit unavailable state avoids displaying invented level flight.
acceptance: Unplug/replug telemetry and individual Ptch/Roll sources; no stale or fabricated level attitude may appear as live.

toolbox: Original AHR chooses airspeed if present, otherwise ground speed; when airspeed is primary, ground speed can be auxiliary.
aerodeck: Flight tape is fixed GS from d.speed; ASpd appears only in Telemetry.
userImpact: A fixed-wing pilot loses airspeed-primary flight presentation although data is sampled.
acceptance: Selectable/automatic airspeed-primary tape with explicit AS/GS labels and simultaneous ground-speed context when available.

toolbox: Original AHR chooses GPS altitude then barometric altitude; supports auxiliary barometric altitude while GPS is primary.
aerodeck: read tries GAlt then Alt into one d.alt; Flight always labels ALT and cannot show both simultaneously or state provenance.
userImpact: The user cannot distinguish an altitude-source fallback or compare sources in Flight.
acceptance: Select/label GPS ASL vs barometric/relative altitude and optionally show secondary altitude; exercise source loss and recovery.

feature: Speed tape ticks and selected value
toolbox: AHR has 7 major positions around selected index, speed 5-unit major spacing with quarter minor ticks and 24 px selection box.
aerodeck: GS km/h equal-width side tape,10-unit ticks with 2.4 px/unit;29 px selected value and fitting.
userImpact: Both provide trend/context and exact selected speed; range conventions differ.
acceptance: Verify zero, low, very high speeds, negative-invalid inputs and long values without partial digits or mislabeled units.

feature: Altitude tape ticks and selected value
toolbox: AHR altitude 50-unit major spacing with minor ticks and 24 px selected box.
aerodeck: ALT m 10-unit ticks at 2.4 px/unit; negative altitude allowed, selected 29 px value fits 38 px.
userImpact: Different scale spacing is a usability choice, not automatic superiority.
acceptance: Check below-sea-level, zero, hundreds/thousands and >five digits; keep selected value distinct from moving labels.

toolbox: AHR shows GPS ground course, optional home bearing; secondary CMP displays course dot against cardinal circle.
aerodeck: Full-width 30 px compass band, heading 29 px badge;15° ticks/30° labels,cardinals and wrap 360.
userImpact: AERODECK preserves ground-course awareness in a different encoding.
acceptance: At 359→0 and headings 15/140 avoid clipped/hidden labels and badge overlap; clearly identify course rather than magnetic heading.

toolbox: AHR can show relative home H marker or offscale arrow and home distance/course context. CMP can show separate home/course points.
aerodeck: Flight footer displays local home distance only; home bearing is on GPS Details/Track page, not projected into cockpit.
userImpact: Returning toward home requires leaving Flight or remembering bearing.
acceptance: Add concise direction-to-home cue with explicit home validity and relative/absolute semantics, preserving full compass readability.

toolbox: TBS GYRO conversion returns sensor value; AHR passes latest values to native HUD. No smoothing filter is proven in those modules.
aerodeck: No interpolation/smoothing in read/poll/cockpit; latest current values rendered.
userImpact: Draw FPS cannot make stale telemetry move smoothly without inventing samples.
acceptance: Record incoming Ptch/Roll timestamps, change cadence and on-screen latency over>=10 minutes under identical link settings; no slowdown after launch.

toolbox: ML.run services MSP/bg and then SN_ATT/SN_BARO/SN_AIR/GPS before UI tasks; task drawing has no explicit per-HUD FPS limiter in UITSKRUN.
aerodeck: pollAttitude runs before throttle and again in sample; full sample/render gated by ceil(100/renderHz), default 25 fps.
dependencies: Telemetry transport including MSP side effects
userImpact: Same native HUD does not ensure same update behavior; source and loop lifecycle matter.
acceptance: On TX 16 S 2.12.4 A/B Toolbox/current app with same model,link,quad: stable draw/value-changeHz, p 95 latency, worst frame stall, memory trend. Desktop WASM is not hardware proof.

toolbox: User observation says Toolbox remains responsive on the same radio. Source proves lifecycle, not measured speed.
aerodeck: In-memory diagnostics separate drawfps and value-changeHz; no SD loop logging. Current release manifest explicitly has hardwarePerformanceMeasured=false.
userImpact: The original user-reported degradation cannot be declared solved by screenshots or constant draw FPS.
acceptance: Same-radio>=10 minute comparison including launch,2 s,1 min,10 min and telemetry reconnect; no progressive stall and value latency at least Toolbox baseline.

toolbox: RCL dashboard has two signal gauges, transmitter-power and RF context backed by generic sensor mappings.
aerodeck: Left Flight rail shows LQ,RSSI,SNR 29 px,Txpower 17 px with units and thresholds.
userImpact: Core link signal values are visible without leaving cockpit.
acceptance: Verify actual mappings,diversity receiver and low/critical limits; missing values muted rather than green.

toolbox: RDB dashboard reads SN 01 transmitter battery value/percent and warning colors.
aerodeck: Flight contains model pack voltage only; no transmitter battery measurement/display in main.
userImpact: The pilot loses radio power context while fullscreen.
acceptance: Display compact transmitter battery warning/value with distinct identity from aircraft pack; respect radio warning configuration.

toolbox: BAT dashboard uses voltage,current,remaining/consumed charge with unit-aware gauges.
aerodeck: Right Flight rail shows pack voltage,percent,USEDmAh,current and derived average cell voltage.
userImpact: Core battery state is visible in Flight; zero and missing are distinct.
acceptance: Real quad validate voltage/current against EdgeTX native telemetry,including 0 A and current stale separately from voltage.

toolbox: BTC conditionally renders actual per-cell values using BT_MD_CELLS_V/BT_MD_CELL_V. CEL shows cell count..S, not the cell array. MPN exposes BTC when array data exists. No BTC/CEL minimum, maximum or delta calculation is proven. Native CRSF per-cell feed from the connected Betaflight/ELRS quad is unverified.
aerodeck: Only derived pack-average cell voltage is displayed; no individual-cell-array reader/presentation.
dependencies: An actual cell-array source from a supported backend
Connected Betaflight/ELRS native CRSF feed unverified
userImpact: Average voltage can hide a weak individual cell, but no renderer can invent genuine per-cell readings from pack voltage.
acceptance: Parity: conditionally display actual reported individual-cell values and a clear no-cell-data state. Never fabricate cell readings from pack average. Proposed improvement: minimum, maximum and delta, explicitly additional rather than claimed Toolbox behavior.
backendAvailability: Unverified for connected Betaflight/ELRS native CRSF
proposedImprovement: Measured minimum/maximum cell voltage and spread from an actual reported array.

toolbox: TIM dashboard draws YYYY-MM-DD and HH:MM from getDateTime.
aerodeck: Global header shows HH:MM cached 1 s; no date display.
userImpact: Time remains available but calendar date is absent.
acceptance: Make date available in a small context/diagnostic view; handle missing RTC without fabricated date.

toolbox: TMR reads selected model.getTimer; supports arm-hosted model timer with start/stop in ML.bg.
aerodeck: Session flightSeconds derives mapped RADIO ARM only while full app runs; rendered on ArmInfo footer, not Flight. No model.getTimer.
userImpact: Elapsed flight time can reset or diverge when leaving the app; it does not replace the radio timer.
acceptance: Read configured model timer; show value/running state in Flight. If optional arm hosting implemented, honor start/stop/reset semantics without silently editing timer ownership.

toolbox: FM dashboard displays current flight mode and arm-state styling.
aerodeck: Global footer displays d.flight; long string fitted to 104 px, currentness required.
userImpact: Flight mode remains accessible on most screens unless higher-priority warning replaces footer.
acceptance: Verify ANGLE/HORIZON/ACRO with arm marker and long FM without clipping; unknown must remain explicit.

toolbox: FMI dashboard has independent IND_AM,IND_RTH,IND_TU icons with priority rules.
aerodeck: No dedicated airmode,RTH,turtle indicator presentation; only FM string and radioArm/radioCut in ArmInfo.
userImpact: Important secondary modes may not appear in generic FM text.
acceptance: Show distinct validated Airmode,RTH/Turtle states with unknown/off/on semantics and no reliance on arbitrary FM substring guesses.

toolbox: THR dashboard panel renders throttle channel percent, cut and configured throttle-limit indication.
aerodeck: No live throttle/limit display. Radio cut is mapped and shown as ON/OFF/-- only in ArmInfo.
userImpact: Pilot cannot inspect throttle output/limit while using Flight.
acceptance: Present normalized actual throttle,cut and limit with clear source/configuration semantics; do not label stick input as motor output.

toolbox: VTX dashboard includes type/source,channel/frequency,power,LPD/PIT state and condition colors.
aerodeck: No live VTX fields on Flight or Video; eight saved frequencies are local notes only.
userImpact: Saved notes cannot confirm actual transmitting channel/power/pit mode.
acceptance: Read actual VTX configuration/status; distinguish reported,pending,confirmed and unavailable values, including PIT/LPD.

toolbox: Model dashboard banner warns arming disabled; Arm Stops module shows reported reasons.
aerodeck: Global footer shows first reason+remaining count, stale/error/unknown states and persistent shield action to explanation/check view.
dependencies: Validated status decoder and fresh disarmed MSP
userImpact: Arming failure is inspectable from any screen,including warnings.
acceptance: Touch/rotary activation from Flight/GPS/Setup returns to origin,retains drafts;API/count unknown must not be misnamed; verify targetFC/radio.

toolbox: SYS represents mspFcReady, mspReady and mspTxReady with a condition-colored MSP indicator. Mute and input-lock are assessed separately in ui-flight-13.
aerodeck: Diagnostics/Setup show transport status including STARTING, IDENTIFYING, WAITING, READY, timeout and TX BUSY. Arm Info separately reports reply freshness. Normal footer intentionally omits MSP link text.
userImpact: Connection/readiness/backpressure information is available with a different hierarchy; this row does not imply mute/lock parity.
acceptance: Under unavailable, unsupported, timeout and transmit backpressure states, show an accurate diagnostic status and recover without flooding. Never display NO FLAGS without a valid reply.

toolbox: SYS displays mute and widget/no-input lock symbols.
aerodeck: No mute toggle/state icon or input-lock icon in app; compact widget contains no controls.
dependencies: Audio/haptic lifecycle and widget input availability
userImpact: User cannot quickly silence app alerts or see that interaction is unavailable.
acceptance: Provide app-level mute with visible state and clear scope; disabled widget interactions must be recognizable.

toolbox: TLM dashboard shows telem quality/off state and dims relevant fields. Module chrome retains left/right signal/battery indicators.
aerodeck: Global red footer when no current telemetry or configured battery/link warning; no-data field states and Diagnostics target.
userImpact: Loss/warning is globally visible,though normal footer content is replaced.
acceptance: Exercise partial source loss and full loss; warnings should identify cause without erasing Arm action or misleading still-current fields.

toolbox: Toolbox module shell retains RC and model-battery vertical sidebars around Telemetry,GPS,VTX,Config,ArmStops,Sticks.
aerodeck: Outside Flight/Data/Power/RC pages,normal footer has FM,home distance,sats,arming flags; no always-visible pack voltage or link quality except alerts.
userImpact: Critical alerts remain, but continuous pack/link glance values disappear on GPS/Setup/Tools/Video.
acceptance: Keep essential pack/link health legible on every screen or prove threshold-only status achieves the same monitoring tasks; avoid duplicate wasted data.

toolbox: Toolbox dashboard scales the model bitmap from /IMAGES and shows model name unless arming blocker overlay.
aerodeck: Global header model name fitted 54 px atTINSIZE; no model image.
userImpact: Long names can become hard to distinguish; decorative model bitmap itself need not be copied.
acceptance: Provide reliably distinguishable active model identity/full name on demand before operation; optional image is aesthetic,not required.

toolbox: Main selector cycles FCD/AHR/battery/VTXfavourites depending sources; secondary cycles attitude,compass,GPS,position; bottom cycles throttle/MSP/memory.
aerodeck: Flight is one fixed PFD; related information is in stable sections/context pages.
userImpact: Functional information can be equivalent without copying the multiplexed layout, but missing alternate capabilities still count.
acceptance: Every conditional Toolbox panel task must have an intuitive AERODECK destination; offer sensible configurable Flight priorities without requiring hidden cycling.

toolbox: GPS module displays latitude/longitude with 7 decimals; dashboard GPS shows 6.
aerodeck: GPS Details 7 decimals;Track 6; validates finite/range and accepts valid 0,0.
userImpact: Position remains inspectable with equal displayed precision.
acceptance: Test hemispheres,±180/±90,0,0,current/stale/invalid tables and native column fit; never substitute missing coordinate 0.

toolbox: GPS module shows speed,ASL altitude and aircraft course with units.
aerodeck: GPS Details speedkm/h,altm,GPScourse; generic alt fallback may become barometric without relabeling.
userImpact: A value may be current yet have ambiguous altitude semantics.
acceptance: Keep GPS ASL provenance explicit; show unavailable if only relative/barometric altitude exists,or relabel source clearly.

toolbox: GPS header/dashboard shows satellite count plus available detailed count when present.
aerodeck: GPS Details large count and global satellite icon+count.
userImpact: Basic satellite count is present.
acceptance: Verify actual count from quad without inferring fix merely from a nonzero count.

toolbox: GPS UI labels POS_FIX as 3 D FIX. Original TBS/CRSF backend defines POS_FIX=Sats>GPS_SATS 2 FIX, not an actual FC fix report. Other backend fix fields require separate verification.
aerodeck: GPS Details truthfully says FIX TYPE NOT REPORTED. Local home gating uses count+valid coordinate, not an actual FC fix.
dependencies: Actual FC/GNSS fix source where available
Explicit distinction between reported and estimated fix
userImpact: Nonzero satellite count does not prove a usable fix. Copying the Toolbox count heuristic as 3 D FIX would be misleading.
acceptance: Read reliable actual no-fix/2 D/3 D state with source freshness where supported. If only a count heuristic exists, label it estimated and retain actual fix UNKNOWN.

toolbox: GPS dashboard displays GPS_HDOP numeric/gauge. Original TBS backend sets it to clamp(Sats−4,0,9) when its count-based fix is true; that is not measured HDOP. Other backends may supply real quality.
aerodeck: No HDOP data or display.
userImpact: An HDOP-looking gauge can mislead if its input is merely satellite count.
acceptance: Show genuine reported HDOP/quality when available. Otherwise report unsupported/unknown or a clearly labeled count estimate; do not implement fake HDOP to imitate the screenshot.

toolbox: GPS module enumerates GPS/SBAS/Galileo/BeiDou/IMES/QZSS/Glonass and satellite ID,10 rows scroll.
aerodeck: Left GPS card contains satellite count/fix-not-reported/local-home state only; no list.
userImpact: The user requested the expanding satellite/config information; count alone is not parity.
acceptance: Provide scrollable per-satellite identity/constellation where FC receiver/protocol supports it; explicit unsupported otherwise.

feature: Per-satellite signal, quality-derived status and use
toolbox: Original satellite handling plus GPS UI prove constellation/ID, quality-derived status, used-state and signal presentation. A SAT_HEAL name table exists, but an independently supplied/displayed satellite-health field is not established.
aerodeck: No per-satellite quality/signal/status/use display. Independent health remains an unknown backend dependency, not a proven extra value to fabricate.
userImpact: The app cannot show searching/lock/use/signal detail. Satellite health must not be inferred from signal or a declared unused name table.
acceptance: Implement the source-proven identity/quality/status/use/signal fields from actual backend data, with scrolling and explicit unsupported states. Add independent health only when a real field and semantics are established.

toolbox: GPS module displays home LAT/LON,distance and heading; TBS backend records home around fix/armed transition.
aerodeck: Local manual/auto home,home coordinates,haversine distance and bearing; explicitly LOCAL HOME.
userImpact: Current local reference is useful but not necessarily FC Rescue home.
acceptance: Distinguish FC-reported rescue home from app-local reference; verify arm/fix transitions,disarm/rearm,telemetry reconnect and manual reset.

toolbox: TBS GPS routine maintains home/fix/armed state as telemetry is serviced globally.
aerodeck: Auto home first captures inside navSnapshot,which runs only while GPS Details/Track render; count threshold not actual fix/arm transition.
userImpact: Opening GPS later can capture a different location than takeoff. Flight footer distance stays unavailable until local home exists.
acceptance: Capture chosen home semantics in shared telemetry state independent of which page is viewed; preserve clear manual override and source label.

feature: Home bearing versus aircraft course cue
toolbox: CMP shows two independently positioned points; AHR can show relative home cue.
aerodeck: GPS Details numericalbearing/course; Track rotates aircraft triangle by course,home at origin. No cockpit relative-home pointer.
userImpact: Navigation tasks require page context; numeric bearing alone is less glanceable in Flight.
acceptance: A distinct direction-to-home cue must remain meaningful with stationary/unknown course; do not equate course and yaw.

toolbox: POS draws clamped relative lat/lon plane icon around home; no map imagery.
aerodeck: North-up metric plot with distance rings,threezoom levels,clipped bounded trail,home and heading triangle.
userImpact: Adds metric spatial context rather than a decorative map.
acceptance: Verify latitude scaling/haversinebearing,zoom distance labels,dateline,large distances,offplot arrow/state and stale trail distinction.

toolbox: POS displays ETHh/m/s from POS_TIMEH; GPS helper calculates travel time with distance/speed units.
aerodeck: No ETH calculation/display.
userImpact: Pilot loses approximate return-time context.
acceptance: Provide explicitly estimated time with assumptions; unavailable at zero/unknown speed; do not call it wind-aware return capability.

toolbox: GPS helper stores bounded positions with date,time,ostime; deduplicates unchanged coordinates. Persistence/export not proven by this helper alone.
aerodeck: navTrack stores onlylat/lon every 1 s while GPS page renders,cap 10..180; no timestamps/movementdedup.
dependencies: GPS logging setting and shared sampler
userImpact: Track history does not cover periods spent on Flight and cannot show age/time of lastknown location.
acceptance: Log bounded timestamped current coordinates independently of selected page; label age of the last known point. Test stationary deduplication and stale/reconnect behavior.

toolbox: GPSINIT implements encodeToPlusCode. This is code capability; a user-facing invocation was not found in inspected UI files.
aerodeck: No Plus Code encoder or display.
userImpact: A source-proven recovery-format capability is absent,though Toolbox UI exposure is not proven.
acceptance: Independently implement standards-valid Plus Code and expose it where useful for recovery; test official vectors. Do not claim Toolbox user-facing parity without identifying its caller.

toolbox: GPS helper observed history is in memory; inspected code does not itself prove SD persistence.
aerodeck: Home/track/lastpoint are session-local; closing/reopening resets them.
userImpact: Do not promise recovery after restart from either in-memory implementation.
acceptance: Trace Toolbox log writers/readers before grading persistence. Separately define and verify AERODECK last-known coordinate retention and power-loss behavior.

toolbox: Toolbox GPS supports satellite-row scrolling, returns to dashboard, and displays MSP information.
aerodeck: Refresh Sensors, Set Local Home and Track Zoom with disabled-home handling; stale coordinates remove current position while an old trail may remain.
userImpact: Own navigation controls can be equivalent without copying Toolbox buttons.
acceptance: Touch and rotary reach every enabled control. Verify stale→live transitions and RTN parent behavior; no Set Home from stale/invalid position.

toolbox: Toolbox MOD/TLM defines a grouped live telemetry table with units and backend-specific rows.
aerodeck: Three columns with nine rows each: RC link, flight data, attitude/GPS. Values come from a shared sample with units, -- and measured fitting.
dependencies: Mapped sources and correct conversion semantics
userImpact: Broad raw-data inspection is available in the AERODECK design.
acceptance: Map every Toolbox sensor row to an equivalent destination and actual unit/provenance. A nominal 27 rows is not proof of all backend sensor support.

toolbox: Toolbox battery/telemetry panels show configured battery values and condition states.
aerodeck: Power adds bounded 90-sample histories at 1 Hz, OFF/NOT FOUND/STALE/INVALID explanations and Sources/Refresh/Limits actions.
userImpact: Provides actionable diagnosis of voltage/current availability.
acceptance: Match native telemetry currentness, explicit None, late binding, genuine zero and per-model profiles. Never fabricate full battery when consumption is missing.

toolbox: Dashboard/module sidebars expose RC quality, power and RF data.
aerodeck: RC Link cards and bounded 90-sample LQ plot; Telemetry also exposes downlink quality and second receiver RSSI.
userImpact: Both support link inspection; AERODECK history provides extra context.
acceptance: Verify actual aliases/units for ELRS and supported FrSky/FC backends. Long values must fit; missing values must not look healthy.

toolbox: VFV displays the configured favourite frequency grid.
aerodeck: Eight local frequency cards with known-band channel derivation, CUSTOM fallback and per-model editing.
userImpact: Saved reference frequencies are useful but separate from actual VTX state.
acceptance: Persist all eight values; fit CUSTOM/channel/frequency labels. A selected note must not imply it is the active transmitter channel.

toolbox: VFV rotary selection plus long ENTER calls SN_VTX(send,frequency,band,channel) when telemetry is on and the VTX is settable/ready.
aerodeck: Reference selection only; explicit LOCAL NOTES / NO VTX COMMANDS, with no apply action.
dependencies: Supported VTX transport and state/capability gates
userImpact: AERODECK cannot change actual VTX frequency. This key-gated functional capability remains required.
acceptance: Independently implement guarded read, validate, apply, acknowledgement and refresh on each supported FC/receiver protocol. Distinguish unknown support and failed/pending/confirmed state.

toolbox: AST displays arming-disabled status/reasons; exact API mapping is covered by the decoder audit.
aerodeck: Arm Info has version/count-gated reasons, explanation/check text and scrolling; unknown flags remain numbered, stale/error status is explicit.
userImpact: Preserves the arming diagnosis task in its own layout.
acceptance: Every supported reason maps correctly; unknown API/count remains numbered. All reason lengths and touch/rotary scrolling must fit.

toolbox: STK has FC-specific stick-command lists and radio stick-mode context.
aerodeck: Betaflight reference only:12 commands over two pages, manual Mode 1..4 selector, paired 18 px diagrams and FC-support caveat.
dependencies: Correct FC type and actual radio stick mode
userImpact: Betaflight reference exists, but other FC variants and automatic mode selection are not proven equivalent.
acceptance: Trace and map every Toolbox FC-specific command list. Read actual radio mode or make the override explicit. Check commands against current primary FC documentation.

toolbox: Configuration categories expand conditionally with capabilities/settings.
aerodeck: Twelve categories with conditional visibility, draft/save/cancel, scrolling and source choices. The separate configuration audit owns field parity.
userImpact: Equal category count does not prove equal settings or functions.
acceptance: Every useful Toolbox setting, including key-gated function behavior, needs working UI and backend. Explain unsupported hardware dependencies explicitly.

toolbox: Telemetry and source configuration use the Toolbox sensor registry.
aerodeck: Tools/Sensors enumerates model sensor 0..63 in five-row pages with current/stale status and refresh. New telemetry discovery remains in EdgeTX.
userImpact: Allows mapping diagnosis without claiming to configure the FC.
acceptance: Expose ID/unit/instance where needed for duplicate-source troubleshooting. Refresh must preserve drafts and use actual qualified sources.

toolbox: MEM displays current/max KB. SYS displays connection, mute and input lock.
aerodeck: Diagnostics shows EdgeTX/build/model, source, MSP, FC/API, writes unavailable, background, draw FPS and value-change Hz; no heap KB.
userImpact: Useful diagnostics exist, but draw FPS alone cannot establish stream latency or memory stability.
acceptance: Show current/high-water Lua heap if available; measure warm cost, memory and sample age without per-frame SD writes.

toolbox: ABT provides app/support information. Activation mechanism is excluded, while useful informational functions remain in scope.
aerodeck: Build and FC/API appear in Diagnostics; no dedicated About/help/support destination.
dependencies: Support metadata and readable full identity
userImpact: Version identification exists; self-service explanation/troubleshooting is limited.
acceptance: Provide build, target capabilities, help and source/provenance without activation machinery. Make complete model/firmware identity readable on demand.

toolbox: MODMENU caches 30 px module icons. SYS enters selection, rotary/ENTER chooses, RTN cancels or returns to dashboard; focused caption explains the target.
aerodeck: Six persistent 30 px section icons with selected plate/underline; SYS focus shows caption, rotary/ENTER/RTN navigate. Home returns to Flight.
dependencies: Real EdgeTX event constants and physical mappings
userImpact: AERODECK uses its own hierarchy; icon recognition is not universally guaranteed.
acceptance: First-time users can find Flight, Data, GPS, Video, Setup and Tools by touch or SYS focus without memorization; selected/focused states remain distinct.

toolbox: Dashboard PAGE events cycle main/secondary panels. Modules have local selection and quick-menu events.
aerodeck: PAGE± cycles six stable section roots. Normal rotary focuses visible local controls; ENTER activates the focused target.
userImpact: Equivalent tasks need not copy dashboard multiplexing.
acceptance: Physical SYS, PAGE±, rotary, ENTER and RTN reach every destination with no invisible action or invalid-event collision.

toolbox: Module header names the current page and presents the primary menu; dashboard subpanels switch independently.
aerodeck: Data has three local tabs, GPS two and Tools three. Arm Info exposes Instruments/Arm Info tabs; Flight itself hides those tabs and uses its compass band. The global footer still renders on both. Setup uses category context; Video has a REFERENCE label.
userImpact: Related tasks are grouped;12 destinations remain the complete current page inventory.
acceptance: Touch/key targets match painted rectangles. On Arm Info, Instruments returns to Flight; Flight uses the persistent footer Arm shortcut. Selected contexts and global footer remain legible, including SYS-focus cancellation.

toolbox: Arm Stops is reachable from menu and dashboard arming warning.
aerodeck: Persistent 48×26 footer action on all 12 pages. RTN returns to origin, including Setup edit/draft; warnings retain the shortcut.
userImpact: Arming diagnosis is reachable without losing the current task.
acceptance: Touch and ENTER from Flight, GPS and Setup editor under normal, warning and stale/error states; RTN preserves selection and draft.

toolbox: Warning conditions use condition colors, dim treatments and dialogs.
aerodeck: Global warning targets Power, RC Link or Diagnostics. Exit modal has highest priority; invalid alert focus is cleared before body rendering.
userImpact: Warnings are actionable and should not leave keyboard focus invisible after clearing.
acceptance: While Setup alert is focused, clear the warning: category highlight and ENTER must recover in the same frame. Alert and Arm touch targets remain distinct.

toolbox: Configuration owns save/exit interactions; exact parity is covered by the configuration audit.
aerodeck: RTN on Flight with drafts opens Keep Editing/Discard Exit. Setup RTN cancels editor before leaving category/list.
userImpact: Avoids silent loss while preserving predictable return paths.
acceptance: Test edit→cancel, save failure, keep editing, discard exit and origin return via touch and keys. No settings write before explicit save.

toolbox: QM fullscreen overlay is registered after OV at priority 0. Its exact action inventory needs caller tracing.
aerodeck: No separate quick-action overlay; section navigation and footer remain available.
userImpact: Actions may be available elsewhere, but quick-menu function coverage is not yet proven.
acceptance: Map every Toolbox quick-menu action, including key-gated functions. Implement useful actions with clear state and few steps, without copying the skin.

toolbox: X.LMK opens a bitmap and converts it to a mask; T.i and MENU cache masks.
aerodeck: Twenty native RGB PNG masks: seven 30 px nav and thirteen 18 px detail/footer glyphs. Successes and failures are cached.
userImpact: Both cache small glyphs, avoiding warm per-frame decode.
acceptance: Each asset opens/converts no more than once per app lifetime. Missing assets use fallback without crash/white box; warm draw performs no SD I/O.

toolbox: AHR uses a 30×6 RGBA aircraft. ATT uses 108×109 RGB JPEG foreground ticks and 108×110 aperture; CMP has 108×110 cardinal mask.
aerodeck: Current Flight uses native HUD plus lines/text, no cockpit bitmap. Icons use cached masks.
dependencies: Source-bound asset dimensions and execution references
userImpact: Different construction methods do not alone establish speed or clarity.
acceptance: Compare functional cues, measured performance and actual native colors; verify all poses clip cleanly.

toolbox: Themes have full-resolution overlay PNGs plus cached small functional masks.
aerodeck: Thirty-nine packaged runtime files include 33 PNGs:20 current icon masks and 13 retained legacy panel/status images, not opened by current main.
dependencies: Release manifest and runtime reference inventory
userImpact: Legacy package size does not imply current draw or decode cost.
acceptance: Distinguish referenced, shipped and retained files. Any removal needs an explicit compatibility plan; this audit performs no cleanup.

toolbox: Packaged raster assets/theme chunks were inspected; no editable vector origins were proven for these masks.
aerodeck: Editable MaterialOutlined original/master SVGs, assets.json, source URLs, modification notices and native PNG exports are stored in development/icons/material.
userImpact: Actual AERODECK glyphs have editable origins without copying Toolbox artwork.
acceptance: Every released glyph maps to official source URL, master, size, hash and modification notice. Include license; exclude test fixtures.

toolbox: THMINIT discovers/sorts themes; THMLD loads selected palette and resolution assets. Four theme families are packaged.
aerodeck: Three accent choices on one flat dark/sky/ground palette; no selectable full contrast themes.
dependencies: Palette/theme configuration and state color semantics
userImpact: Functional contrast/theme choice is only partially replaced; exact textures remain optional.
acceptance: Offer usable contrast palettes across all screens and states. Carbon/leather/wood decorative matching is not required.

toolbox: UI_THM_OV enables full-resolution overlay. With overlay off, UITSKRUN draws frames.
aerodeck: Current UI uses flat native geometry and no full-screen decorative overlay.
userImpact: Decorative identity can differ if every function remains clear.
acceptance: Preserve AERODECK identity and legibility; do not count absence of a Toolbox texture as a functional gap.

toolbox: AHR rails use RCF(...BLACK,12), header bands use 5. Native rectangle argument 6 is four-bit opacity.
aerodeck: Flat rails and plates use opaque rectangle fills.
userImpact: Do not assume Toolbox rails are opaque when calculating visible field area.
acceptance: Real-estate comparisons must account for actual opacity and readable content; do not turn geometry into an unsupported superiority percentage.

toolbox: T.i caches masks; AHR creates local drawing closures during draw, and module switching reloads tasks.
aerodeck: Glyph geometry, controls and table rows are cached; some cockpit helper closures and Power button descriptors are created during drawing.
dependencies: Actual Lua heap/GC and target hardware
userImpact: Both allocate; source allocation counts alone are not a benchmark.
acceptance: Measure heap trend, GC stalls and worst frame cost on the same hardware; reuse hot-loop objects when it removes a measured issue.

toolbox: UIML clears old task state, loads the next module and collects. Overlay is lazy-cached per module.
aerodeck: One full app retains closures/icon masks. changePage clears asset/background state and collects; cached masks survive page switches.
userImpact: Lifecycle differences affect cold switches, warm frame cost and ceiling.
acceptance: Profile cold switches, ten-minute warm use and repeated page cycles. No growing heap, asset failure or progressive delay on actual 2.12.4.

feature: Measured text fitting and long values
toolbox: Fixed-resolution layouts and fonts; reference screenshots prove fit only for their shown values.
aerodeck: Flight, Power and Telemetry use measured fitting. Sensors uses fixed 20-character truncation and columns; RC Link large values lack measured fitting.
dependencies: Actual native font metrics and extreme-value fixtures
userImpact: Normal images do not prove long names or extreme data fit every screen.
acceptance: Native stress each field with long/wide/negative values, names, missing data and warnings. Measure before fitting and expose full detail when selected. Do not claim overlap without a reproduced image.

toolbox: Package has 480×272 UI/assets. MAIN/RD records actual LCD width/height.
aerodeck: Full-screen geometry is 480×272, matching TX 16 S MkII target.
userImpact: Primary target resolution is implemented.
acceptance: Verify all 12 screens, physical inputs, fonts, telemetry and asset paths on the TX 16 S. Synthetic 3.0 WASM is additional evidence, not target proof.

toolbox: Package has distinct 480×320 layouts, graphics and all four theme-resolution directories.
aerodeck: Full-screen coordinates remain 480×272; compact widget alone uses zone geometry.
userImpact: Extra vertical area/native geometry is not adapted; this capability stays in replacement scope.
acceptance: Implement/native-verify 480×320 layout with all functions, readable targets and warnings. Do not infer adaptation from image stretching.

toolbox: Package has distinct 800×480 UI and graphics/themes.
aerodeck: No 800×480 full-screen layout or coordinate adapter.
userImpact: TX 16 S success does not establish all Toolbox platform coverage.
acceptance: Independent 800×480 layout and official simulator/hardware QA for all functions; preserve hierarchy without simply stretching 480 px coordinates.

toolbox: UIINIT checks resolution paths and contains fallback logic; recovered branch needs original validation. This package has no 320×240 UI.
aerodeck: No explicit full-screen LCD width/height guard before hard-coded 480×272 drawing.
userImpact: Unsupported displays may get clipping instead of a clear message.
acceptance: Detect exact capabilities, choose supported layout and otherwise report unsupported. A fallback string does not prove 320×240 support.

toolbox: Tool and full-screen WG entry modes are present. Original widget background guard tests APP.initDone, while M returns{G,F,D,X} and sets G.initDone; reachability of that hidden/background path is not proven.
aerodeck: Tool returns init/run/stop. Full-screen widget loads the same app; compact/background calls stop and releases it. Target-radio widget execution remains unverified.
userImpact: Entry forms exist, but source presence must not be inflated into proven background behavior.
acceptance: Verify real launch/exit/background/model change/resume on target radio. Confirm no compact/background MSP traffic and no duplicate state. Independently implement the required lifecycle rather than reproducing an unproven guard.

toolbox: Original widget loader requires a full-screen APP layout; a non-fullscreen zone draws the title and Select APP mode layout, not compact telemetry cards.
aerodeck: Compact widget displays name, live voltage, LQ and current where the zone fits; smallest zones show name/voltage. Full-screen app is released during background/compact use.
dependencies: Saved per-model mappings and current samples
userImpact: Useful compact telemetry is an AERODECK addition rather than missing Toolbox parity. Performance and lifecycle still require separate verification.
acceptance: Verify standard zones, fonts, units, freshness, model switching and background CPU/memory alongside other widgets on actual radio.

toolbox: RDKEY has multiple physical/virtual key fallbacks. MAIN/RD records radio, firmware, color and resolution.
aerodeck: Current app uses virtual keys plus guarded SYS/MENU and a touch/rotary contract for the primary target.
dependencies: Real firmware/event API on each radio
userImpact: Supporting a resolution alone does not cover a radio family.
acceptance: Publish and test radio×resolution×firmware×touch/key coverage, including physical keys, fonts and Bitmap APIs. Do not claim OpenTX without evidence.

toolbox: Original package and user observation prove capability presence, not every hardware condition.
aerodeck: POWER-LIVE has 22 exact-source 480×272 synthetic AOS 5 screenshots from EdgeTX 3.0 WASM. Target is 2.12.4; hardware pose/performance/widget verification flags remain false.
dependencies: Actual target radio/quad and controlled conditions
userImpact: Synthetic desktop rendering cannot certify complete hardware replacement.
acceptance: Bind exact build, model and RF settings to real currentness, pose, sustained latency, physical input and widget results. Never ship fixture code/settings.

toolbox: FCD provides a scrollable Firmware/FC panel: firmware name/version, API, target name and Betaflight manufacturer ID when supported.
aerodeck: Diagnostics shows FC firmware version and API plus EdgeTX/build/model; no FC target/manufacturer identity.
userImpact: Support and target identification are incomplete even though version/API are present.
acceptance: Read and display actual FC name, target/manufacturer and version fields with capability gating and safe string bounds; distinguish missing from unsupported.

toolbox: FCD defines gyroscope, accelerometer, magnetometer, barometer, GPS, sonar and pitot states, with ACTIVE/UNAVAILABLE/UNHEALTHY labels. Conditional backend support must be verified.
aerodeck: No FC hardware sensor-health list; Tools/Sensors lists EdgeTX telemetry sources, which is a different concept.
userImpact: A discovered radio telemetry source does not establish that its underlying FC sensor is healthy.
acceptance: Independently expose FC-reported sensor present/active/health states where supported; label unknown explicitly. Do not derive hardware health from stale telemetry or arming flags alone.

feature: Five favourite pack selection and remaining charge
toolbox: BFV provides five configured packs plus auto-sense option with chemistry, cells and capacity, rotary selection and ENTER apply.
aerodeck: Five pack favourites plus automatic mode in Configuration; selected cells/capacity feed live remaining charge and estimate marker on Power. Per-pack chemistry parity is left to the configuration audit.
dependencies: Actual selected profile and consumed capacity
userImpact: The core pack-selection and remaining-capacity task is implemented without requiring dashboard tiles.
acceptance: All five profiles are reachable by touch/rotary, selection survives verified save/reopen, and remaining charge follows the selected capacity. Missing consumption must not fabricate full battery.
